parameters.name: EventId
parameters.description: The ID of the system event.

parameters.name: OpsType
parameters.description:
The type of the O\&M task. Valid values:

*   immediate
*   scheduled

parameters.name: PlanTime
parameters.description: The execution time of the reservation. The timestamp is measured in milliseconds. If the OpsType parameter is set to scheduled, this parameter is required.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens event-redeploy-instance --event-id e-d71ff150945b9c02eb6ebc0016328468 --resource-id i-55qi8m11rr53c4i964md8a00l --ops-type immediate --plan-time 1742452232000 --plan-utc-time example-string --region cn-hangzhou
